title: AniRec — next-tab concepts
question: Choose a layout, combine parts, or request a revision. Each board shows Library, Profile, Compare, and Settings using illustrative sample data; no tabs have been implemented yet.

options.label: A · Comparison matrix
options.thesis: Aligned rows make personal signals and differences easy to scan.
options.viewport: Library is a decision ledger; Profile pairs scores with evidence; Compare aligns both ratings; Settings groups labeled rows.
options.risk: Efficient and precise, but less artwork-forward.

options.label: B · Split workbench
options.thesis: Browse on the left and inspect evidence on the right without losing your place.
options.viewport: Library keeps a selected title open; Profile expands one signal; Compare explains one disagreement; Settings exposes one section.
options.risk: Focused on desktop, but the inspector needs a separate mobile view.

options.label: C · Library-led workspace
options.thesis: Recognizable titles lead, with evidence attached directly to each anime.
options.viewport: Library uses shelves; Profile leads with revealing titles; Compare groups shared favorites and disagreements; Settings stays practical.
options.risk: More inviting to browse, but fewer items fit on screen.
